name: Wounded Ancients
summary: In the Stonetalon Mountains, the treants have turned against the land they once guarded. Kaela Shadowspear suspects goblin munitions are to blame and asks you to recover shrapnel from the corrupted guardians for Gaxim Rustfizzle to examine.

sections.title: Blighted Protectors
sections.body: The treants once guarded the groves of Stonetalon, gentle yet fierce, bound to the health of the land. When the Venture Company arrived with buzzsaws, explosives, and strip-mining, the forest fought back. The treants drove the invaders from parts of the vale, but their victory came at a cost. They did not return to their peaceful watch. Instead, they became hostile and maddened.

sections.title: Gnomish Investigation
sections.body: Kaela Shadowspear, an Alliance scout in the mountains, believes the treants suffer from no natural sickness. Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome engineer, suspects the goblins' weapons and chemicals harmed them during the Venture Company's chaotic retreat. He hopes to learn whether Venture Company ordnance is poisoning Stonetalon's ancient protectors by studying corroded shrapnel from the wounded treants.

faq.q: Who offers the quest Wounded Ancients?
faq.answer: Kaela Shadowspear, an Alliance scout in the Stonetalon Mountains, offers this work. She watches the growing conflict and harm to the land.
Gaxim Rustfizzle suspects Venture Company munitions lodged in the treants during the goblins' chaotic retreat. He believes the weapons are poisoning and maddening the forest guardians.

faq.q: What item must be retrieved for this task?
faq.answer: You need to recover a piece of Corroded Shrapnel from the bark and flesh of the wounded treants wandering the area.
Gaxim Rustfizzle is a gnome engineer allied with the Alliance who assists Kaela Shadowspear. He uses his mechanical skill to study Venture Company weapons and how they harm natural life.

faq.q: What is the Venture Company's presence in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: The Venture Company is a goblin logging and mining syndicate that invaded Stonetalon. It cuts down sacred woodlands and plunders mineral deposits without regard for the land's balance.

faq.q: Does collecting the shrapnel heal the treants?
faq.answer: No. The shrapnel is a sample for Gaxim to examine so he can learn the toxin's nature and origin. It does not immediately cure the corrupted guardians.

angles.text: For a Kaldorei sworn to protect Kalimdor's wilds, seeing ancient woodland guardians twisted by goblin industry is an outrage.
Gaxim Rustfizzle shows how mechanical skill can help uncover and understand the harm caused by reckless engineers.
Treants carry nature's life within them. Removing the foreign metal poisoning their flesh is a grim necessity as you confront the Venture Company's destruction.
The corroded metal in the treants reveals the careless work behind Venture Company munitions beside the precision of gnomish craft.
